{{Top|leg}}
'''Ah'Kra'Tais''' was the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ah'Kra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. Its name translated as "Common-craftersland" in the [[Coynite language]].
